sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
சிறுவாலை எனும் சிற்றூர் வந்தாருங்க
நறுமலர் மாலையுடன் நின்ற வரத வினாயகருங்க
sections.translit:
siRuvAlai enum sitRUr vandhArunga
naRumalar mAlaiyudan nindRa varadha vinAyagarunga
sections.en: Sri Varada Vinayagar came and stood wearing a fragrant flower garland, in a small village called Siruvalai.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
லட்சணமாய் மக்களெல்லாம் வந்தாருங்க
லட்சார்ச்சனை நேமமாய் செய்தாருங்க
sections.translit:
latchaNamAy makkaLellAm vandhArunga
latchArcchanai nEmamAy seydhArunga
sections.en: People, properly assembled, performed a prayer, rigorously chanting His name one hundred thousand times according to the procedures laid down in the scriptures.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
திருமால் இருந்த ஊர் தானுங்க ஆனாலும்
மருமான் பெயர் விளங்கச் செய்தாருங்க
உருவில் பருமனார் நினைவில் அன்பர் மோதகம்
தெருவில் உள்ள ஜனங்களுக்கு நெறய தந்தாருங்க
sections.translit:
thirumAl irundha Ur dhAnunga AnAlum
marumAn peyar viLangach cheidhArunga
uruvil parumanAr ninaivil anbar mOdhakam
theruvil uLLa janangaLukku neRaya thandhArunga
sections.en: This is a place Lord Vishnu used to reside. He has made the name of his nephew known far and wide. After making an offering to the presiding deity, Ganapathy, devotees distributed a lot of modhakams, which are sweet dumplings made of rice flour, coconut, ghee, and jaggery. They were distributed to people  residing in the streets of Siruvalai.

notes: The unwritten local legend (sthalapuranam) of the Varada Vinayagar temple in Siruvalai was verbally conveyed to the author in the 1980s by his late father, Sri G. Ramachandra Iyer. He recounted that a group of Brahmins, perhaps due to a drought, moved south from the village of Minmini near Kancheepuram and settled in Siruvalai. The village's original temple was dedicated to Lord Vishnu, but the settlers replaced the Vishnu idol with a Vinayaka statue from a different temple. This idol is now worshipped as Varada Vinayagar.
